Section: Use of automated means for content moderation
Indicator: Number of measures solely taken by automated means
Contextual Information: The number of measures solely taken by automated means represents enforcement actions implemented without prior human review in defined and limited scenarios. The remaining measures reported in the template arise either from user-submitted notices or from proactive detection followed by human review. Accordingly, not all measures taken at Depop’s own initiative are solely automated.

Section: Use of automated means for content moderation
Indicator: Number of measures not taken by automated means
Contextual Information: The number of measures not taken by automated means reflects enforcement actions where the final decision was made by a human moderator. This includes measures following user notices and measures resulting from automated detection that were subsequently reviewed and decided by trained moderation personnel. These cases involve human assessment of context, intent, and policy application prior to enforcement.

Section: Use of automated means for content moderation
Indicator: Accuracy of the automated means - Accuracy
Contextual Information:
The performance and accuracy of automated systems are monitored through a combination of human review outcomes, quality assurance processes, and appeal analysis.

For content detected by automated means, subsequent human review outcomes are used as an indicator of alignment between automated signals and policy enforcement decisions. Metrics such as the proportion of automated flags resulting in confirmed violations, overturn rates following appeal, and QA sampling results are reviewed to identify potential over/under flagging.

Where automated enforcement occurs without prior human review in defined scenarios, post-enforcement monitoring and appeal outcomes are used as performance indicators. Identified trends may result in threshold adjustments, workflow refinements, or model tuning.

This approach allows Depop to assess the effectiveness of automated systems in practice, even where formal precision/recall metrics are not calculated or externally reported.
